_comment: Tracked PLACEHOLDER. Real tokens belong in user_configs/credentials/inbound/consumer_tokens.json, which takes precedence and is not tracked. Every entry here is switched off, so this file can never gate or grant anything by accident. Every entry names the account it acts for (inbound/accounts.json); a switched-off example may name one that does not exist.

example_viewer.note: Example only. The viewer reads every surface, acting for a person's account.

example_partner.note: Example only. Market data, and deliberately nothing on reports. A sibling service acts for a SERVICE account.
